g.title: AgentMemoryPipeline
g.text: Communication Architecture — 3 Agent Channels, 8 Silent Operations, 48 Tools

g.title: SilentOps
g.text: deleteExpiredNodes() src/storage/expiration.ts — nodes vanish silently, no notification
applyScoreDecay() src/storage/predictive-rating.ts — triggered on session.idle, scores drop between turns
runConsolidation() src/storage/compress-ops.ts — creates fact:* nodes from episodic clusters
distillRules() — appends learned lessons to rule:mandatory:memory, affects next session's system prompt
LRU + TTL in src/cache.ts — max 8 entries/session, 2h TTL, entries dropped without notice
scheduledBackgroundEmbeddings() — auto-generates embeddings for nodes missing them, 1s post-init
memory(mode="prune")(dryRun=false) returns only node count, not list of deleted nodes
session.compacting — creates middle-term:* + storedcontext:* nodes, agent sees summaries only
